personas.name: F-E Developer
personas.reaction: A drift, a way back for the direction of travel and a sixth key all touch the step every kart takes and the keys every player saved; that is where a regression hides, and the design at least says a kart that never hops drives as today.

personas.name: B-E DEv

personas.name: Paul - Product Manager
personas.reaction: One playtest line turned into a drift, a rocket start and a slipstream in a single PRD: the kind of fast follow-up I want from the loop.

personas.name: Lead Engineer
personas.reaction: The engine, the rivals, the keys and the sound in one PRD are four reviews; I can live with it if each lands on its own.

personas.name: Irisa

objection.text: Je vois déjà cet outil comme un gadget, et un sixième PRD sur le kart plutôt que sur l'outil me le confirme. Si le jeu reste, qu'au moins il ne me coûte rien à relire : un seul PRD qui touche le moteur, les rivaux, les touches et le son d'un coup, c'est trop.
